precondition.description: Declared by the caller, checked by the adapter before the host is touched. Failure is precondition_failed and the host was not invoked.

field.description: Profile-defined assertable field: url, title (browser); stopped, thread_id (dap).

surface.description: Opaque, server-minted. Never parsed by clients.

precondition.title: HostProto precondition v1

actions.description: Intent kinds this target declares. An undeclared action is capability_unsupported, not attempted.

revision.description: Revision the target was observed at. An adapter MUST reject a target whose revision differs from the surface's current revision before invoking the host (error target_invalidated).

role.description: Profile-defined: link, textbox, file (browser); thread, frame, scope, variable (dap).

surface.description: Opaque, server-minted. Never parsed by clients.

target_id.description: Opaque, server-minted. Never parsed by clients.

action_id.description: Opaque, server-minted. Never parsed by clients.

decision_token.description: For intents that resolve a host-owned request (dialog, permission, file chooser). Consumed exactly once.

declared_effects.description: What the caller expects to change. Compared against Receipt.effects by conformance tooling, never enforced by the adapter.

kind.description: Member of the adapter profile's closed intent family.

surface.description: Opaque, server-minted. Never parsed by clients.
